# opnsense_syslog_destination (Resource)

Remote syslog destinations forward OPNsense logs to an external log collector (System ‣ Settings ‣ Logging ‣ Remote).

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Forward firewall logs to a remote CrowdSec log collector
resource "opnsense_syslog_destination" "crowdsec" {
  hostname    = "192.0.2.10"
  port        = "514"
  transport   = "udp4"
  facility    = ["local0"]
  description = "CrowdSec log collector"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP address of the remote log collector.

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) ID (refid) of the certificate to use for `tls4`/`tls6` transports. Defaults to `""`.
- `description` (String) Description for this remote logging target.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this remote logging target. Defaults to `true`.
- `facility` (Set of String) Syslog facilities to forward (e.g. `local0`, `auth`, `kern`). Leave empty to forward all facilities. Defaults to `[]`.
- `level` (String) Minimum log level to forward (e.g. `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `err`, `crit`). Leave `""` to forward all levels. Defaults to `""`.
- `port` (String) Port of the remote log collector. Defaults to `514`.
- `program` (Set of String) Applications/programs to forward (e.g. `filterlog`, `suricata`). Leave empty to forward all applications. Defaults to `[]`.
- `rfc5424` (Boolean) When enabled, uses RFC 5424 message format instead of the legacy RFC 3164 format. Defaults to `false`.
- `transport` (String) Transport used to deliver log messages. One of `udp4`, `udp6`, `tcp4`, `tcp6`, `tls4`, `tls6`. Defaults to `udp4`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the remote logging target.
